test_objective: Check that you cannot retrieve a Context Source Registration, if the context source registration id is not a valid URI
keywords: Retrieve Context Source Registration With An Invalid Id

test_cases.name: 036_01_01 Invalid Id
test_cases.doc: Check that you cannot retrieve a Context Source Registration, if the context source registration id is not a valid URI
test_cases.template: Retrieve Context Source Registration With An Invalid Id
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/csourceRegistrations/{context_source_registration_id}'
        method set to 'GET'
        Retrieve Context Source Registration with data: and
    Query Parameter: context source registration id set to 'invalidUri'
}
